description: Use this when you need to know when a US healthcare provider must revalidate its Medicare enrollment (PECOS). For 1 to 50 NPI numbers: each Medicare enrollment (Part A, DME, Non-DME Part B) with its revalidation due date read from the official CMS Revalidation Due Date List, days left, status (upcoming, date_passed, not_set) and list version. No names returned. Not a consumer report under the FCRA. Not affiliated with or endorsed by CMS or the U.S. Government. Price: 0.01 USDC per call (x402). Free trial: set free_trial to true (3 calls per day per caller).

free_trial.description: Set to true to ask for the free trial (3 calls per day per caller, shared with the web route, within a daily cap for the service). Without it, the tool asks for an x402 payment.

npi.description: 1 to 50 NPI numbers (10 digits, valid check digit), comma-separated

name: revalidation_lookup

data.description: Data source, license and the only fields read

disclaimer.description: Not legal advice; not affiliated with CMS; not a consumer report

licence.description: Licence of the source data: nom, url, source

list_version.description: Version of the CMS list read, e.g. 2026-11-01

note.description: How to read not_set, no extensions, when to file

official_tool.description: CMS lookup tool, the authoritative record

results.description: One entry per NPI: npi, found, enrollments (enrollment_id: organizations only, null for an individual practitioner's enrollment; state, enrollment_type {code, label: Part A, DME, Non-DME Part B}, provider_type, specialty, revalidation_due_date, adjusted_due_date, due_date (the earlier date), later_due_date, status (upcoming, date_passed, not_set), days_left, as_of, time_zone)

rules.description: Rules applied, with official URL and status
